errors.text: The antiferromagnetic interaction is recast as an interfacial exchange-spring coupling between C14 Ti and the fcc matrix, whereas the target attributes it more generally to antiparallel Ti and Fe/Co/Ni sublattice moments and reports ferromagnetic ground states for both phases.

The cited evidence does not directly support magnetic coupling, electronic structure, or coercivity in dual-phase FeCoNiTi; two citations concern unrelated alloy systems and one concerns mechanical strengthening.
